pull_request.title: doc: remove remaining uses of `@@wellknown` syntax
pull_request.body:
The use of `@@` to describe well-known symbols in ecma-262 is now historical. This patch removes the last few uses within the docs.

Refs: https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/pull/1314
